description: The SARB (South African Reserve Bank) Policy Rate — South Africa's benchmark monetary-policy interest rate, set by the Monetary Policy Committee. Returns the current rate, the date it took effect, the previous rate and when that one took effect, plus recent decision history (TimeseriesCode MMRD002A), computed from several years of daily observations rather than sarb_timeseries's narrow default window.
name: sarb_policy_rate
